title: msm status document, schema version 1
description: Printed by `msm <server|all> status --format json` and `msm server list --format json`.

schema_version.description: Incremented when a field is removed, renamed or changes meaning. Adding a field does not change it.

servers.description: One entry per server, sorted by name. Empty when there are no servers.

active.description: Whether the server is meant to be running: its active marker exists. `msm <server> start` sets it, `msm <server> stop` clears it; the global start and stop leave it alone.

state.description: What the manager can prove about the server's process. occupied: a screen session holds the server's name but is not verifiably this server (treat it as possibly running). unknown: the sessions could not be inspected.

ok.description: True when nothing needs attention: an active server is running, or an inactive one is stopped. False for every other combination, including occupied and unknown.

detail.description: Why the state is occupied or unknown. Absent for running and stopped.
